name: iced matcha latte
description: A smooth and refreshing iced drink made with matcha, milk, and a touch of honey for natural sweetness.
steps: Whisk matcha powder with cold water until smooth and lump-free.
Stir honey into the matcha mixture until dissolved.
Fill a glass with ice.
Pour milk into the glass over the ice.
Slowly pour the prepared matcha mixture over the milk.
Stir before drinking.

name: hot matcha latte
description: A warm and creamy matcha latte balanced with honey, vanilla, and a small pinch of sea salt.
steps: Warm the milk until steamy but not boiling.
Whisk matcha powder with a small splash of hot water until smooth.
Stir in honey, vanilla extract, and a pinch of sea salt.
Combine the matcha mixture with the warm milk and froth if desired.
Serve immediately and enjoy.

name: mango matcha latte
description: A tropical layered drink that blends sweet mango with creamy milk and earthy matcha.
steps: Whisk matcha powder with warm water until smooth and frothy.
Blend mango pulp with milk and sweetener until combined.
Fill a glass with ice.
Pour the mango-milk blend over the ice.
Slowly pour the prepared matcha mixture on top.
Stir gently before drinking.

name: pumpkin spice maple matcha latte
description: A cozy autumn-inspired iced matcha drink with pumpkin spice, maple sweetness, and creamy foam.
steps: Sift matcha powder into a bowl and add pumpkin spice.
Pour hot water over the matcha and whisk until smooth and frothy.
Add 10g pumpkin puree and the 15ml maple syrup to the matcha mixture and whisk until combined.
In a separate cup, froth the heavy cream, 15ml milk, 5ml maple syrup (foam), and remaining 5g pumpkin puree until thick and creamy.
Fill a glass with ice and pour in the matcha base.
Add the non-dairy milk and stir gently.
Spoon the sweet cream foam on top and finish with a pinch of ground cinnamon.

name: matcha mocha latte
description: A rich and comforting latte combining earthy matcha with smooth cacao and warm milk.
steps: Whisk matcha powder and cacao powder with hot water until smooth and lump-free.
Steam or froth the milk until creamy.
Pour the milk into the matcha-cacao mixture.
Add maple syrup or coconut sugar to taste and stir well before serving.

name: tropical matcha
description: A bright and refreshing matcha drink mixed with sweet pineapple juice for a tropical twist.
steps: Whisk matcha powder with hot water until smooth and frothy.
Pour pineapple juice into a glass.
Slowly add the prepared matcha mixture to the juice, stirring gently.
Add ice cubes if desired.
Garnish with a pineapple slice or mint leaf and serve immediately.

name: blueberry matcha fizz
description: A sparkling matcha drink with muddled blueberries, lemon juice, and refreshing soda water.
steps: Whisk the matcha powder with the 40ml water until smooth. Set aside.
Place the blueberries in a cocktail shaker or small mixing glass. Lightly muddle them to release the juice.
Add the simple syrup and lemon juice. Stir briefly to combine.
Add ice, close the shaker, and shake for about 10–15 seconds until the mixture is well chilled.
Strain or pour the mixture into a glass filled with fresh ice.
Top with soda water.
Carefully pour the prepared matcha over the top so it floats slightly.

name: coconut matcha refresher
description: A light and hydrating drink made with coconut water, matcha, and a touch of creamy coconut.
steps: Sift matcha powder into a bowl to remove lumps.
Add warm water and whisk the matcha until smooth and slightly frothy.
Fill a glass with ice.
Pour coconut water and cold water into the glass.
Slowly pour the prepared matcha over the coconut water to create a layered drink.
Lightly whisk coconut cream and gently spoon it on top if using.
Add sweetener if desired and stir before drinking.
Finish with the optional squeeze of lime juice and mint, if using.

name: iced raspberry matcha latte
description: A fruity iced matcha latte layered with fresh raspberries, milk, and smooth matcha.
steps: Whisk matcha powder with hot water until smooth.
Add raspberries to a glass and lightly mash them.
Fill the glass with ice.
Pour milk into the glass.
Slowly pour the matcha mixture over the milk to create a layered drink.
Stir before drinking if desired.

name: warm vanilla matcha
description: A comforting matcha drink with warm milk, gentle vanilla flavor, and light sweetness.
steps: Whisk matcha powder with warm water in a bowl until smooth and lump-free.
Heat the milk until warm but not boiling.
Stir vanilla extract and sweetener into the warm milk.
Pour the milk into a cup.
Add the prepared matcha and mix gently.
Serve warm.

name: tiramisu matcha latte
description: A dessert-style latte that blends matcha, coffee, creamy milk, and mascarpone topping.
steps: Mix mascarpone with sugar or maple syrup in a small bowl until smooth and slightly fluffy.
Whisk matcha powder with hot water until completely smooth.
Pour espresso or strong coffee into the matcha and stir gently.
Heat the milk and froth lightly.
Add the warm milk to the matcha-coffee mixture.
Spoon the mascarpone cream on top before serving.

name: salted caramel latte
description: A warm coffee latte with caramel, foamed milk, and a small pinch of sea salt.
steps: Prepare the espresso or strong coffee and pour it into a cup.
Stir in the caramel sauce and a small pinch of sea salt until combined.
Warm the milk until steamy but not boiling, then froth lightly.
Pour the warm milk over the caramel coffee and spoon the foam on top.
Serve warm.

name: pistachio creamy latte
description: A smooth latte flavored with pistachio paste and lightly sweetened for a nutty, creamy taste.
steps: Prepare a shot of espresso or strong coffee and pour it into a cup.
Heat the milk until warm and froth lightly.
Stir pistachio paste, honey or sugar, and vanilla extract into the coffee until smooth.
Pour the warm milk into the cup and stir gently to combine.
Serve immediately.

name: spanish latte
description: A sweet and creamy espresso drink made with milk and condensed milk.
steps: Prepare a shot of espresso and pour it into a cup.
Add sweetened condensed milk and stir until combined.
Heat the milk until warm and froth lightly.
Pour the warm milk into the espresso mixture and stir gently.
Serve immediately.

name: white mocha coffee
description: A creamy coffee drink combining espresso, milk, and melted white chocolate.
steps: Melt the white chocolate in a cup using a small amount of hot milk or microwave.
Prepare a shot of espresso and pour it over the melted white chocolate, stirring until smooth.
Heat the milk until warm and froth lightly.
Pour the warm milk into the espresso mixture and stir gently.
Add a small amount of vanilla extract if desired and serve.

name: iced coconut coffee
description: A refreshing iced coffee with coconut milk and a hint of sweetness.
steps: Brew strong coffee and allow it to cool slightly.
Fill a glass with ice.
Pour the coffee over the ice.
Add coconut milk and coconut syrup or honey.
Stir gently to combine and serve.

name: irish latte
description: A warm espresso drink mixed with Irish whiskey, brown sugar, milk, and whipped cream.
steps: Prepare a shot of espresso and pour it into a heatproof glass.
Add Irish whiskey and brown sugar, then stir until the sugar dissolves.
Heat the milk until warm and froth lightly.
Pour the warm milk into the espresso mixture.
Top with whipped cream and serve immediately.

name: strawberry cold foam hojicha
description: A refreshing iced hojicha drink topped with sweet strawberry cold foam.
steps: Whisk hojicha powder with 60ml cold water until smooth.
Fill a glass with ice and pour the prepared hojicha over it.
Add the remaining 60ml cold water and stir gently.
In a separate cup combine milk and strawberry syrup and add food coloring if desired.
Froth the milk mixture until thick and foamy.
Pour the strawberry cold foam over the iced hojicha and serve.

name: coconut hojicha cloud
description: A tropical iced drink with coconut water and a creamy hojicha foam layer.
steps: Fill a glass with ice and pour coconut water over it.
In a separate cup combine hojicha powder, chilled coconut cream, milk, and vanilla syrup.
Froth the mixture briefly with a milk frother until smooth and pourable.
Slowly pour the hojicha cream foam over the coconut water.
Serve immediately and stir before drinking if desired.

name: strawberry hojicha latte
description: A layered drink combining sweet strawberries, creamy milk, and roasted hojicha tea.
steps: Dice strawberries and mix with sugar in a small bowl.
Let the strawberries sit for 15–30 minutes until they release juice and become syrupy.
Gently mash the strawberries and add them to the bottom of a tall glass.
Fill the glass with ice and slowly pour milk over the strawberry layer.
Whisk hojicha powder with cold water until smooth.
Slowly pour the prepared hojicha over the ice to create a layered drink and serve.

name: maple hojicha latte macchiato
description: A layered latte with maple-sweetened milk and roasted hojicha poured through the foam.
steps: Steam and froth the milk together with maple syrup until creamy and foamy.
Slowly pour the foamed milk into a glass or mug.
Whisk hojicha powder with filtered hot water (around 80°C) until smooth.
Slowly pour the whisked hojicha into the center of the milk foam to create layers.
Serve immediately and enjoy.

name: hojicha rose tea latte
description: A floral latte combining fragrant rose tea with smooth roasted hojicha and milk.
steps: Steep dried rose buds in filtered water at 95°C for 5 minutes.
Whisk hojicha powder with half of the rose tea until fully dissolved, then add the remaining rose tea and stir.
Add maple syrup and mix well.
Steam and froth the milk, then pour into the hojicha-rose tea mixture.
Lightly crush a few dried rose buds and sprinkle with dried rose petals on top for garnish.
Serve warm and enjoy.

name: lavender hojicha latte
description: A calming latte made with roasted hojicha tea and fragrant lavender infusion.
steps: Steep dried lavender buds in filtered water at 95°C for 5 minutes.
Whisk hojicha powder with half of the lavender tea until fully dissolved.
Add the remaining lavender tea and maple syrup, mixing well.
Steam and froth the milk, then pour onto the hojicha-lavender mixture.
Lightly sprinkle dried lavender buds on top for garnish.
Serve warm and enjoy.

name: flat white
description: A compact espresso drink with warm milk and a fine, silky layer of foam.
steps: Prepare the espresso and pour it into a small cup.
Warm the milk until steamy but not boiling.
Froth briefly to create fine bubbles, then tap the jug gently to settle any large bubbles.
Pour the milk slowly into the espresso, keeping the foam layer thin.
Serve immediately.

name: cappuccino
description: Espresso topped with warm milk and a generous cap of soft foam.
steps: Prepare the espresso in a cup.
Heat the milk until steamy but not boiling.
Froth the warm milk until it has a thick layer of foam.
Pour the liquid milk into the espresso, holding the foam back with a spoon.
Spoon the remaining foam onto the drink and serve.

name: café mocha
description: A comforting blend of coffee, cocoa, and warm milk.
steps: Mix the cocoa powder and sugar with the hot water in a cup to make a smooth paste.
Prepare the espresso and stir it into the cocoa paste.
Heat the milk until steamy but not boiling.
Froth the milk lightly, then pour it into the chocolate coffee.
Stir gently and serve warm.

name: honey cinnamon latte
description: A mellow coffee latte sweetened with honey and a hint of cinnamon.
steps: Prepare the espresso in a cup.
Stir the honey and cinnamon into the hot espresso.
Warm the milk until steamy but not boiling.
Froth the milk lightly and pour it into the cup.
Stir gently before serving.

name: cardamom latte
description: Warm milk and espresso scented with a small pinch of ground cardamom.
steps: Prepare the espresso in a cup.
Combine the milk and cardamom in a small saucepan.
Warm gently until steamy but not boiling, stirring to disperse the spice.
Stir the maple syrup into the espresso.
Froth the spiced milk lightly and pour it over the espresso.

name: vanilla iced latte
description: A simple iced coffee with creamy milk and soft vanilla sweetness.
steps: Prepare the espresso, stir in the vanilla syrup, and let it cool until no longer hot.
Fill a tall glass with the ice.
Pour the milk over the ice.
Add the cooled vanilla espresso.
Stir gently and serve cold.

name: iced americano
description: Chilled espresso and water over ice for a light, refreshing coffee.
steps: Prepare the espresso and let it cool until no longer hot.
Fill a glass with the ice.
Pour the cold water over the ice.
Add the cooled espresso.
Stir once and serve immediately.

name: espresso tonic
description: A crisp, bittersweet drink with espresso floating over chilled tonic.
steps: Prepare the espresso and let it cool completely.
Fill a tall glass with ice and add the orange slice.
Pour the chilled tonic water into the glass, leaving room at the top.
Slowly pour the cooled espresso over the back of a spoon onto the tonic to limit foaming.
Stir gently if desired and serve immediately.

name: shaken brown sugar espresso
description: Cooled espresso shaken with brown sugar and ice, then finished with milk.
steps: Prepare the espresso and stir in the brown sugar until dissolved.
Let the sweetened espresso cool completely before putting it in a closed shaker.
Put 60g of the ice and the cooled espresso into a cocktail shaker. Close and shake for about 10 seconds.
Fill a glass with the remaining 80g ice and strain the shaken espresso into it.
Pour the milk over the coffee and serve.

name: maple oat latte
description: A soft, gently sweet coffee latte with oat milk and maple syrup.
steps: Prepare the espresso in a cup.
Stir in the maple syrup.
Warm the oat milk until steamy but not boiling.
Froth the oat milk lightly.
Pour the oat milk into the espresso and serve.

name: orange mocha
description: Chocolate coffee with a bright orange note and warm milk.
steps: Mix the cocoa powder, sugar, and hot water in a cup until smooth.
Prepare the espresso and stir it into the cocoa paste.
Warm the milk with the orange zest until steamy but not boiling.
Let the milk stand for 2 minutes, then strain through a fine sieve.
Pour the orange-scented milk into the chocolate coffee and stir.

name: iced lavender latte
description: A lightly floral iced coffee made with culinary lavender syrup.
steps: Prepare the espresso and mix in the lavender syrup.
Let the espresso cool until no longer hot.
Fill a glass with the ice.
Pour in the milk, then add the cooled espresso.
Stir gently and serve.

name: spiced chai latte
description: Black tea simmered with ginger and whole spices, then softened with milk.
steps: Place the water, ginger, cardamom, cinnamon, and clove in a small saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the black tea bag and steep over low heat for 3 minutes.
Remove the tea bag, then add the milk and sugar.
Warm gently without boiling, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
Strain the drink through a fine sieve into a cup and serve.

name: dirty chai latte
description: A gently spiced black-tea latte with an extra shot of espresso.
steps: Steep the chai tea bag in the hot water for 5 minutes, or for the time on its packet.
Remove the tea bag.
Prepare the espresso and add it to the brewed chai.
Stir in the maple syrup.
Warm and lightly froth the milk, then pour it into the chai coffee.

name: london fog
description: A fragrant Earl Grey tea latte with vanilla and softly frothed milk.
steps: Steep the Earl Grey tea bag in the hot water for 3–4 minutes.
Remove the tea bag and stir in the vanilla syrup.
Warm the milk until steamy but not boiling.
Froth the milk lightly.
Pour the milk into the tea and spoon the foam on top.

name: iced peach black tea
description: Black tea chilled with mashed ripe peach and a little honey.
steps: Steep the black tea bag in the hot water for 3 minutes.
Remove the tea bag, stir in the honey, and let the tea cool.
Mash the peach flesh in a bowl until juicy.
Add the peach to a glass and fill with ice.
Pour the cooled tea over the fruit and stir.

name: honey lemon ginger tea
description: A warming ginger infusion with lemon juice and honey.
steps: Put the water and sliced ginger in a small saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer and simmer for 5 minutes.
Strain the ginger infusion into a heatproof cup.
Stir in the lemon juice and honey.
Let the drink cool to a comfortable drinking temperature before serving.

name: mint green tea
description: A light green-tea infusion with fresh mint leaves.
steps: Heat the water to the temperature recommended on the tea packet; around 80°C suits many green teas.
Place the tea bag and mint leaves in a heatproof cup.
Pour in the hot water and steep for 2–3 minutes, or follow the packet time.
Remove the tea bag and mint leaves.
Stir in the optional honey and serve.

name: rose milk tea
description: Black tea with warm milk and a small splash of culinary rose water.
steps: Steep the black tea bag in the hot water for 3 minutes.
Remove the tea bag and stir in the sugar until dissolved.
Warm the milk until steamy but not boiling.
Pour the warm milk into the tea.
Stir in the rose water and serve.

name: classic hot chocolate
description: A rich, smooth hot chocolate made with cocoa and dark chocolate.
steps: Mix the cocoa powder and sugar with 30ml of the milk in a small saucepan to form a smooth paste.
Gradually whisk in the remaining 220ml milk.
Warm gently, stirring, until steamy but not boiling.
Add the chopped dark chocolate and stir until fully melted.
Pour into a cup and serve.

name: cinnamon hot chocolate
description: Creamy dark hot chocolate with cinnamon and a little vanilla.
steps: Mix the cocoa powder, sugar, and cinnamon with 30ml of the milk in a small saucepan.
Whisk in the remaining 220ml milk until smooth.
Warm gently until steamy but not boiling.
Add the chopped chocolate and stir until melted.
Stir in the vanilla extract and pour into a cup.

name: iced chocolate milk
description: A cold, creamy cocoa drink with a smooth homemade chocolate base.
steps: Mix the cocoa powder and sugar with the hot water until smooth.
Let the cocoa mixture cool until no longer hot.
Stir 50ml of the milk into the cocoa mixture to loosen it.
Fill a glass with ice, then add the chocolate base.
Pour in the remaining 170ml milk and stir thoroughly.

name: strawberry milk
description: Fresh strawberries and milk blended into a lightly sweet pink drink.
steps: Wash and hull the strawberries, then cut them into pieces.
Place the strawberries, chilled milk, and sugar in a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

name: mango lassi
description: A thick, tangy mango and yogurt drink with a hint of cardamom.
steps: Peel the mango, remove its stone, and measure 120g of flesh.
Put the mango, yogurt, chilled milk, and cardamom in a blender.
Add the optional sugar if the mango needs extra sweetness.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a glass and serve cold.

name: raspberry lemonade
description: Tart lemon and fresh raspberries over ice, lightly sweetened with sugar.
steps: Stir the sugar into the warm water until dissolved, then let it cool.
Mash the raspberries in a bowl and pass them through a fine sieve to remove the seeds.
Mix the raspberry juice, lemon juice, cooled syrup, and cold water.
Fill a glass with ice.
Pour the lemonade over the ice and stir.

name: cucumber mint cooler
description: A fresh sparkling drink with cucumber, mint, and lime.
steps: Put the cucumber slices and mint in a tall glass.
Press gently with a muddler or the back of a spoon to release their flavor.
Add the lime juice and simple syrup, then stir.
Fill the glass with ice.
Top with the chilled sparkling water and stir gently.

name: sparkling hibiscus tea
description: A jewel-red hibiscus infusion brightened with sparkling water and orange.
steps: Steep the dried hibiscus in the hot water for 5 minutes.
Strain into a heatproof jug and stir in the sugar until dissolved.
Let the infusion cool completely.
Fill a glass with ice and add the orange slice.
Pour in the cooled hibiscus infusion, top with sparkling water, and stir gently.
